source_member: iOS 27 - Icon Templates - Illustrator/App Icon Template.ai
method: Read the PDF-compatible Illustrator page MediaBox and vector content in optional-content group /MC6, named Grid, using pypdf. No raster tracing.
interpretation: Fit the longer glyph dimension to the central-circle bounding square (inner square guides), preserving aspect ratio. This is measured grid geometry, not a universal Apple glyph percentage.
inner_circle_evidence: Grid (/MC6): translation (512,768); cubic path runs from local (0,0) through (256,-256), (0,-512), (-256,-256), back to (0,0).
optical_offset_basis: Lumen optical adjustment for the heavy-base silhouette; other glyphs retain geometric centering.
